Back when I was still in the Philippines, I didn't have much options for Ina merch as it was expensive and out of pocket. Luckily, I managed to find a fellow Takodachi back home who was selling handmade crochet Takodachis and I decided to use my savings to buy one. Upon getting him, I named him Albert Takosworth, and took it along with me everywhere. It eventually became a sort of good luck charm for me since it was my closest connection to you in terms of merch. And with that luck, the possibility of my family moving to the US was granted. Short of a miracle, good things kept coming when I had him with me which I always linked with you. Ina way, you are involved in this entire path that opened up for me. Sounds ridiculous but I like to think it that way. That smol Takodachi gave me hope everyday that things would turn out great. As seen, I had him with me during the flight to guarantee safe travels and I still have him with me, resting among the Ina plushies I managed to purchase now that I have a slightly better sitting in life. I do still take him with me when going to new places.

As it can be seen, this is my Ina merch haul at the moment. None of them are displayed and are all kept safe and store in a box for now. I wish to properly enshrine them for the world to see or whoever enters my room when I get my own someday. The joy of receiving merch of you is always great, especially ones with your signature on it. I honestly think I have developed a hording instinct when it comes to your merch. XD

I always keep some of your merch on me or near me at all times, mainly because seeing them makes me happy and creates a little comfort bubble. Like how I put Ina the Hero plush in my car as my driving buddy, though her string snapped, she now rides shotgun. Thinking if I should keep it that way or find a way to reattach the string so she can chill by the windshield like she used to.
Happy 6th anniversary Ina! I hope you like this illustration! I wish you all the best and am looking forward to all your future projects and streams 💜

Hi Ina! Just wanna say thank you for all the comfy and fun streams that always manage to brighten my mood whenever I'm feeling tired. Thank you so much for always giving your best for us and for continuing to be here with us after all these years.

Looking back, I still find it kinda funny to think that the shy girl who used to hide from her family just to do karaoke streams would eventually make it onto the big stage and even do her own Duolive with Kiara. So proud and happy to see how far you've come! I hope everything you work on, every goal you set, and every dream you want to achieve goes smoothly. I'll always be cheering you on along the way!

Here's a photo I took back during Hololive World Tour 2024: Soar in Indonesia. Still genuinely stands as one of the best day of my live since it was my first time attending a live concert after all those years cheering from in front of my PC screen. 

Have a WAHnderful day Ina, and Happy 6th Anniversary!

Over the years Ina gathered more and more Takodachis in various shapes and sizes.

With that, I'm looking forward to a future with lots of new Takodachis joining us and one day we'll realize your dream of world domination ;).

Happy 6th Anniversary, Inaaa!! Before watching you, it's been years, or more than a decade ever since i draw something, and have any other approach in photography beside generic scenery. You have inspired me, together with many takos, i think in not just like.. doing art, but at least to me, is also the expression, being true to myself through art, through a mix of what i am willing to dive in: photography and painting (O wO)b (also it's pretty cool to see Ninomanyo and Takodachi are like Tsubaki and Fake Rider in Fate/Strange Fake) It's not like a work of art, or something i may love so much, but it's "me".. heh.. and thank you Ina for giving me a way to learn it!!

I want to tell a bit about photos I made for this occasion. It was made during a sunset in Kyiv on one of the peaks in the city. It was also raining, which created a magical view of the sky. It was hard to stop taking photos lol.
Here is another photo from this place.

On the way back I saw a place called "Art Arsenal". While holding a plushie of an artist it seemed a good idea to visit the place dedicated to art. It turned out that Ukrainian Fashion Week was taking place there at that very moment. Unfortunately, entry to the fashion show itself was restricted to those with invitations from the designers, the event’s patrons and members of the press. However, the exhibition of clothes on mannequins was open to the general public and looked simply stunning! The fashion show’s visitors themselves were also beautifully dressed in interesting and unusual outfits.

My other message is that I hope you continue to be an amazing artist. Be it with all the stuff you do for Hololive, your MVs, for anyone who commissions you, to even friends. And it can also be the funny like you did here. In short, just continue to be you, Ina

I found you and Myth takes the same position as mine, being the very first generation of hololive English. I can feel the same that it's very stressful and exausting to take care of everything by yourself without adequate help from outside.
Now I'm pretty much used to live in this country and, I'm happy with who I am! I'm a tech engineer and an artist! I'm pretty confident to say that you and Myth are able to handle whatever happens nice and carefully!

Congratulations Ina and Myth on 6 years! Ina, Myth and HoloEn have had such a positive uplifting effect on my life for these past 6 years. I have put together a collage with some photos I have taken over the past few years documenting all the cool events I was able to attend. I would never have guessed when I first saw Myth debut I would get to see so many amazing Hololive concerts and pop up stores in both the US and Japan. These are all thanks to the hard work all the EN girls! Attending events and collabs is fun but even more amazing is all of the interactions with fans and friends I have made at these events. The Hololive fan community especially the overseas ones started off small and has grown to a big welcoming family. 

Congrats again on 6 years~!
